raw_text: BREAKING: Heavy gunfire reported near Khartoum International Airport. RSF forces appear to be moving on SAF positions across the capital. Multiple sources confirm clashes at the presidential palace compound. Rapid Support Forces have seized several key bridges over the Nile. Communications disrupted in central Khartoum.
